description: Claude Code plugin adapter. Bundles the platform-neutral UI/UX Skill as a Claude Code plugin with MCP tool exposure through the shared stdio transport. Contains no design, knowledge, eval or runtime logic.

knowledge.rule: Load SKILL.md first; retrieve knowledge by id or collection through retrieve_knowledge, never whole folders.

bundle_layout.note: The full generic package is the plugin root; SKILL.md and all relative links stay unchanged.

limitations: Claude Code live host test has not been executed; structural and subprocess verification only.
No min_version for Claude Code is declared: the plugin structure has been verified against docs as of 2026-09-25 but not against a pinned host release.
Python 3 must be available on PATH; the plugin does not bundle or install a Python runtime.
